evidence: Market coverage across May 10, 2022, is heavily dominated by acute downward liquidity pressure and contagion risks. Most critically, the Luna Foundation Guard deployed hundreds of millions of dollars from its Bitcoin treasury to defend the collapsing UST peg, triggering severe market-wide liquidation and forced selling. Concurrently, exchange inflows reached a three-month high as investors moved coins to centralized venues to de-risk, and MicroStrategy faced market scrutiny regarding potential margin call collateral thresholds. Counterbalancing bullish factors include El Salvador's purchase of 500 BTC and isolated dip-buying commentary, but these are vastly overshadowed by systemic stablecoin insolvency risk and extreme sell-side pressure.
limitations: All evidence comes from unverified free crypto news outlets rather than tier-1 financial journalism.
Multiple articles reporting El Salvador's 500 BTC purchase and MicroStrategy collateral statements were consolidated as single signals.
Snapshot availability and later revisions are caller-attested, not independently verified.
reference_price_definition: Binance BTCUSDT daily candle close at the contract timestamp
